approach.method_basis: The Parent searches a persistent tree of newly generated molecular graph edits. Each occurrence retains its own completed returns, best received return and pending reservations. Related siblings share completed support, peak values and pending density through molecular similarity when choosing the next branch; widening still uses actual local counts. It purchases the generated frontier directly. After accepted feedback strictly improves the incumbent, it starts a fresh tree from that molecule while retaining the global accepted archive and receipt ledger.
approach.novelty: Remove only the influence of other siblings' unresolved work on deeper exploration. A branch will retain shared completed support and shared peak value, but its exploration denominator will count only its own pending reservations. Prior siblings removed shared value alone or value and both densities together, changed root membership, or excluded certified exhausted branches. None isolates pending sharing while retaining completed sharing and value on this Parent.

hypothesis: At existing-child choices with parent_id != 0 only, remove off-diagonal sibling pending density from the exploration consumer. For each eligible sibling j retain D_j=sum_k K_jk*N_k, B_j=sum_{k:N_k>0} K_jk*N_k*M_k and P_j=sum_k K_jk*O_k, but set active started_j=D_j+O_j in place of D_j+P_j. Exploitation remains B_j/D_j when D_j>0, else the inherited neutral 0.5. The exploration bonus is the inherited beta*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/started_j) when started_j>0; priority is started_j==0. This removes borrowed unresolved work while retaining actual own pending discouragement and all shared completed/value evidence. At identical exposed states the denominator cannot increase, so the bonus cannot decrease where both are defined, and a zero-start priority can be restored. The hypothesis is that this changes deeper choices and reaches actual paid paths without altering retained consumers or accounting. Whether the altered paths preserve or improve score is a separate measured conditional contribution question.

finding_summary.headline: Pending-only removal changed paid paths but lost endpoint score; retained sharing helped conditionally
finding_summary.insights: This isolated comparison supports a positive conditional endpoint contribution from discouraging deeper choices using unresolved work on similar siblings, while shared completed support and shared peak values remain present. It does not establish that every such discouragement helps: removal produced more improvements and more late gain, but smaller total progress. Large losses on two DRD2 seeds and one sitagliptin seed outweigh the smaller gains elsewhere; later recovery is therefore insufficient evidence of final-search success. The result refutes the registered non-inferiority prediction for this removal, while confirming its direct operation. It leaves other ways to use pending information, other retained compositions and the wider approach open. The trajectories also narrow the method diagnosis. Deeper occurrence revisits fell from 5,320 to 2,970, yet fragment-excluded within-session similarity increased from 0.211 to 0.229 and molecules above fifty heavy atoms increased from 301 to 557. Tiny products fell from 425 to 318, and distinct scaffold counts changed only modestly. This is neither evidence that more revisiting caused the loss nor a clean global scaffold-collapse result. Together with the Molecular report’s unstable bonding contexts and unexpressed stereochemistry, it points to a graph-proposal limitation: preserving a coherent core, useful size and chemical state while making structural changes remains unreliable. A proposal operator or search scheme that preserves those features could address that limitation; these observations do not identify a beneficial cutoff, prove chemical quality or mediate the score difference. Oracle time rose from 500.05 to 1160.91 seconds on the realized streams; matching historical Candidate clocks and precise late timing are unavailable, so a paired computational-efficiency conclusion remains open. No technical execution failure occurred, and the evidence is sufficient for this finite conditional contrast, not independent replication or broad generalization.
finding_summary.results: The intended numerical and path changes occurred: 24,287 of 31,123 deeper candidate rows changed, 1,637 of 4,655 deeper choices changed, and 1,557 of 4,350 purchased molecules lay on a changed path. Every task/seed was exposed, and the audit found no change to the retained value, completed-count, root, widening or accounting laws. The complete paired mean fell from 0.499496 to 0.458310, a loss of 0.041186. Nine task/seed endpoints improved and six worsened; seed-level mean differences were −0.076412, +0.008704 and −0.055850. Full-run strict improvements rose from 148 to 183, but total incumbent gain fell from 4.365063 to 3.747273 on the same 4,350-purchase denominator. Late gain rose from 1.367463 to 2.120851 over 2,175 purchases, with 42 versus 68 strict improvements. Thus direct activation succeeded while the explicitly registered score-preservation falsifier triggered. The formal Anchor mean was 0.607030, leaving a separate deficit of 0.148720 and its +0.002 performance goal unmet.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich, halogenated scaffolds span compact amines to oversized hybrids, with persistent reactive bonds and unspecified stereochemistry.
molecular.overall_character: Child n-6a1ce58741d7 and actual code Parent n-e4b751133c75 each have complete paired Search seeds 0/1/2 over the five frozen tasks: 15 task/seed cells, 4,500 accepted records including 150 initial records and 4,350 paid optimizer records per node. context.comparison separately confirms child_complete=true and paired_complete=true, with no profile-mismatched seeds. No trajectories are missing. All chemistry comparisons here use the actual code Parent; no new formal-Anchor molecular comparison was performed. The output is chemically broad at graph level: aromatic carboxamides, pyrazolines/thioamides, heavily substituted heteroarenes, flexible arylalkylamines, cyclic ureas, sulfonamides and densely fused saturated heterocycles coexist with tiny fragments and very large recombined molecules. On the full paid denominator, the Child has 3,899 ring-bearing and 3,249 aromatic-ring-bearing molecules, versus Parent 3,762 and 3,396. It has 3,410 halogen-bearing molecules. Rich ring content and broad scaffold diversity do not establish makeability: compact plausible substructures coexist with peroxide, hypohalite, N-halogen and crowded polycyclic examples. Size tails are Child 318/4,350 below six heavy atoms and 557/4,350 above fifty, versus Parent 425/4,350 and 301/4,350. Late means optimizer ordinals 146..290 inclusive, equivalently trajectory evaluations 156..300: Child tails 157/2,175 and 304/2,175 versus Parent 195/2,175 and 204/2,175. Thus fewer very small products coexist with more very large ones. Sums of session-unique nonempty typed/generic Murcko scaffolds are Child 1,914/1,516 versus Parent 1,904/1,486 full, and Child 1,033/822 versus Parent 1,021/799 late; these are sums of within-cell identities, not global unique scaffolds. Fragment-excluded similarity uses all unordered within-session pairs of connected molecules with at least six heavy atoms, radius-2 RDKit Morgan sparse count fingerprints and RDKit count Tanimoto. Equal-cell mean similarities are Child 0.22881660151384065 versus Parent 0.21055317448418243 full, and 0.269893535801028 versus 0.25435788806897514 late. These numbers describe local structural concentration only. Child graph flags count 492 molecules with O-O bonds, 561 with O-halogen bonds and 108 with N-halogen bonds, versus Parent 171, 504 and 289; the flags overlap and are structural alerts, not experimentally measured toxicity or stability. No Child paid molecule has explicit formal charge or a specified tetrahedral stereocentre, although RDKit finds unassigned centres in 2,510/4,350; neutral SMILES does not imply absence of protonatable amines. Synthetic routes, isolation, conformational feasibility and solution protonation are not measured. Only accepted Search trajectories were inspected; rejected proposals and pending/unreturned terminal chemistry cannot be recovered from these files. Candidate runtime, oracle timing and mechanism activation are outside this molecular reading. Associations between molecules and scalar returns are not attribution to the intervention or proof of a target pharmacophore. Exact definitions, all per-cell denominators, completion checks and aggregate counts are in policy/scratch/r0057-02-improve-L01-molecular/audit-summary.json. Original paths and SHA-256 hashes are in policy/scratch/r0057-02-improve-L01-molecular/inputs-sha256.json. Child copies below preserve the exact bytes of the frozen request's trusted staging trajectories and confer no new citation authority; Parent files are the published trajectories named by focus.artifacts and the Search-only evidence_index. Each per-task entry cites its paired audit and both raw files.

transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A task-agnostic generator would need chemically consistent creation and retention of stereochemical state when editing saturated or bridged scaffolds. The present panel has no controlled stereoisomer contrast, so the useful score effect of doing so remains unmeasured and cannot be inferred from the scalar outcomes.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
